name: Sheet Pan Asian Chicken Drumsticks with Broccoli & Spiced Walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F, position a rack in the center position and another in the bottom position. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil (optional).
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
4 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar to the bowl and whisk to combine the marinade. Add the chicken and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
4 tsp chili-garlic sauce
brown sugar
2 ½ lb chicken drumsticks

instructions.primary_message: Spread chicken out in a single layer on a prepared sheet pan. Place on the bottom rack of the oven and roast until the chicken is cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Reserve marinade.
Wash broccoli and cut into small, bite-sized florets. Thinly slice the thicker stem. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Toss broccoli with soy sauce and oil. Spread out in a single layer on the other baking sheet and place in the oven for 5-8 minutes while you prepare the nuts.
Remove chicken from the oven. Use tongs to flip each drumstick. Spoon on remaining marinade, and return to the oven.
Roughly chop walnuts. In a small bowl, toss walnuts with water to moisten.
In another small bowl, stir together sugar, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper. Toss moistened walnuts in the spice mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
brown sugar
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove the broccoli pan from the oven and sprinkle the walnuts on top. Return the pan to the oven for an additional 5-8 minutes or until broccoli is tender-crisp, and walnuts are toasted.
To serve, place chicken, broccoli, and walnuts on a plate. Enjoy!
